name: vnd-ai-sdlc
description: VNDIRECT AI-SDLC harness, framework-agnostic layer: /harness-init bootstraps the harness into any repo by detecting its real toolchain and layout; upstream discovery commands (idea-card, problem-canvas, discovery-report) and /gate for recording the human G1 feasibility decision; architect/reviewer/security agents; delivery commands (plan-feature, spec, adr, review, security-review, pr, status, agent-metrics, update-memory, abort); a governed skill lifecycle (skill-new, skill-submit, skill-approve, skill-sync); versioned templates for every phase-boundary artefact (traceability manifest, PR, Jira ticket, SKILL.md, Idea Card, Problem Statement Canvas, Discovery Report); and a self-contained bundled MCP server exposing Confluence, Jira, GitHub, GitLab, Microsoft Teams and Claude Code trigger tools. /pr now works on both GitHub and GitLab. Pair with vnd-ai-sdlc-stockbook for Flutter specifics.
